reason: I'd only pay for something that moves a metric, and there's no proof here that a cute mascot lifts conversion. At ~$1,400/month revenue, 29 EUR is a real chunk, and the free plan or a trial would tell me everything I need before paying.
objection: An AI that clicks and acts on my site, fills forms and starts checkout, could do something wrong in front of my customers, and I have no A/B data showing it helps conversion rather than distracting people.
would_change_my_mind: A controlled A/B test or case study from a similar small SaaS showing a measurable lift in signups or conversion, plus hard guardrails that stop the agent from taking any action I haven't approved.
